verdict.rationale: Inngest lets developers write ordinary TypeScript, Python, or Go functions with steps that are automatically checkpointed/memoized and resumed from the last successful point, with no YAML or proprietary DSL — supported by docs and corroborated by community devs praising the natural, code-first DX versus alternatives like Temporal. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark or deeper multi-language proof beyond docs claims.
